subject: [PATCH v4 3/4] btrfs: handle ENOMEM from btrfs_insert_dir_item() without aborting

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Btrfs file system to handle ENOMEM errors when inserting directory items without aborting the transaction. It adds -ENOMEM to the list of recoverable errors in btrfs_add_link() and updates btrfs_create_new_inode() to orphan newly-created inodes instead of aborting on ENOMEM. This change allows create(), mkdir(), mknod(), symlink(), and link() operations to return a graceful -ENOMEM error under memory pressure, preventing filesystem-killing aborts.
